name: com.midtrans.sdk.uikit.views.indosat_dompetku.IndosatDompetkuPaymentActivity
description: When a user selects Indosat Dompetku mobile-wallet payments in Midtrans UiKit checkout, this screen collects the requested phone detail and submits the wallet payment.
disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent users from completing payments with Indosat Dompetku mobile-wallet payments.
